scope: Five fixed Imagegen PNG concepts; independent read-only game_reviewer; no PixelLab or runtime assessment
verdict: APPROVE for concept selection; user acceptance remains open
shared: Four readable tabs, three squad cards, visible matte wood button faces and clear main CTA.
D01: Strongest direct dungeon cue: doors, hinges, keyholes and gate CTA; portal is large but lettering clear.
D02: Stone arches, torches and staircase communicate dungeon architecture; masonry dominates and shrinks courtyard.
D03: Rope, key/map, pickaxes, lanterns and stairs communicate expedition tools with wood prominent; corners and hanging map are busy.
D04: Rails, gears, chains and portcullis form a distinct trap mechanism; density and industrial tone may overwhelm wood.
D05: Skull keystones, runes, bones and webs clearly communicate crypt; heavy borders narrow the theme toward undead.
limitations: Shared courtyard and hero arrangement. D02/D04/D05 allocate much space to ornament. Not implementation readiness.
